comparison_scope: Claim-level comparison to inspected primary sources; added means explicit content here relative to the cited construction, not a claim of novelty or priority across literature.

rows.primary_source: Jhawar and Wang, When Is Test-Time Adaptation Identifiable from Unlabeled Evidence? (2026), Definition 1, Theorem 1, Corollary 1
rows.primary_claim: Oracle-action identification on evidence-law fibres; indistinguishable worlds with different unique optima imply equal-prior error >=1/2; approximate TV testing bound.
rows.inherited: Indistinguishable-world testing and decision identification without full risk identification are established principles.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: For a fixed binary pair and declared disagreement residual budget: constructive clipped benefit set, exact strict-sign boundary abs(M)>beta, zero-benefit closed-boundary semantics, and fibre-wise residual audit floor.
rows.not_added: No priority for generic TTA nonidentifiability, Le Cam testing, or action identification. No universal multiclass or data-dependent-action frontier.
rows.assumptions: Binary 0/1 loss, d>0, feasible M, measurable kernels, full declared kernel class; beta externally supplied.

rows.primary_source: Li, Han and Ma, From Matrix Inversion to Constraints (2026), Proposition 3.1, Theorem 3.2, Corollary 3.3
rows.primary_claim: Joint label-shift weight region represented by matrix inequalities; LP coordinate bounds refine interval-inversion regions with finite-sample coverage.
rows.inherited: Probability-box containment, matrix constraints, LP optimization, and union-bound confidence construction.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Joint prediction bins for a fixed candidate/baseline pair; shared-table paired accuracy contrast; mass variables t,s,pi with aggregate conditional-TV slack rho; exact finite-model sign decisions without prior identification and cancellation examples.
rows.not_added: Not a new general LP confidence method. No blanket dominance over MaC regions or prior work; tighter contrast versus separate subtraction holds only on the same feasible set.
rows.assumptions: Fixed pair, iid evidence sampling, simultaneous exact probability boxes, externally valid rho; all bins retained.
rows.assessment: conditional paired-objective extension; numerical endpoint certification excluded

rows.primary_source: Danilowski et al., MORPHEUS (ICLR 2026 TTU workshop), Sections 2-3
rows.primary_claim: Regression from source-model entropy and neural-collapse features predicts post-adaptation accuracy and selects among TTA methods before executing adaptation.
rows.inherited: Label-free meta-prediction and adaptation selection are prior practice.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: One-pair empirical benefit prediction with an interval-derived adapt/freeze/abstain operating point and explicit identification/calibration limits.
rows.not_added: No first label-free performance predictor or adaptation selector; no proof of improved ranking, no superiority established by an unmatched baseline, and no claim that post-candidate features match pre-adaptation compute.
rows.assumptions: Prespecified empirical target and evaluation unit, valid marginal coverage for any claimed error control.
rows.assessment: different target and decision interface; empirical advantage unresolved

rows.primary_source: Qiu and Stoye, Statistical Decisions and Partial Identification (2026), abstract and decision-theoretic setting
rows.primary_claim: Statistical decisions can be analyzed with partially identified effects and application-specific restrictions.
rows.inherited: Decision-making over identified sets and sensitivity restrictions.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Explicit binary paired-benefit set and strict-direction abstention convention for the stated TTA residual class.
rows.not_added: Not a new general theory of partial identification, minimax regret, or sensitivity analysis.
rows.assumptions: Full declared class and strict direction, rather than a general welfare-loss optimum.
rows.assessment: domain-specific construction; source used for conceptual positioning only

rows.primary_source: Lei et al., Distribution-Free Predictive Inference for Regression (2018), split conformal construction
rows.primary_claim: Split conformal obtains marginal predictive coverage using an independently fitted predictor and calibrated residual order statistics under exchangeable sampling.
rows.inherited: Residual rank calibration and coverage event containment.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Application to paired evaluation-cell benefit, strict three-way action, and an explicit separation from a population residual budget.
rows.not_added: No new conformal validity theorem, conditional acceptance guarantee, or automatic population-risk guarantee.
rows.assumptions: Compatible fitting/calibration/new-unit protocol, unit definition, exchangeability, infinite radius when rank unavailable.

rows.primary_source: Barber et al., Conformal Prediction Beyond Exchangeability (2023)
rows.primary_claim: Quantifies coverage loss from distribution drift and fitting asymmetry for original conformal procedures; modified weighted and randomized constructions can improve robustness.
rows.inherited: Calibration transfer cannot be inferred from the conformal label or pooled inclusion alone.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Explicitly conditional coverage-to-action contract and separately audited calibration assumptions.
rows.not_added: No new distribution-shift coverage correction or verification of exchangeability for the recorded panels.
rows.assumptions: The actual deployment score law must meet the specified calibration contract.

rows.primary_source: Clopper and Pearson (1934), The Use of Confidence or Fiducial Limits Illustrated in the Case of the Binomial
rows.primary_claim: Binomial tail inversion constructs probability intervals with controlled repeated-sampling error.
rows.inherited: Exact binomial intervals and Bonferroni union bound for simultaneous boxes.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Insertion of these boxes into the paired transport feasible set and benefit projection.
rows.not_added: No new binomial interval; numerical inverse-beta plus one ULP is not a formal exact-CDF certificate.
rows.assumptions: Binomial margins under iid class-conditional/source and target-bin sampling; exact endpoints for theorem.

rows.primary_source: Hoeffding (1963), Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables
rows.primary_claim: Independent bounded sums obey exponential deviation bounds.
rows.added_in_this_manuscript: Range-two accuracy-benefit radius combined with cell prediction radius; explicit fresh-sample/frozen-candidate protocol.
rows.not_added: No concentration for arbitrary macro-F1 or transductive batch adaptation; no new concentration inequality.
rows.assumptions: m>0 fresh conditionally iid paired correctness differences in [-1,1].
rows.assessment: conditional application; publisher metadata verified, publisher full text unavailable in this audit
